en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard-style photograph showing several children and a dog on a wooded hillside. Leafless or sparsely leaved trees frame the scene, with a faint building visible to the right background. Some children sit on the ground while others stand on the slope above. The image has a coarse halftone print texture and a small rectangular mark with the initials 'PAG' in the lower-right corner.
